headline: Pick a Plan
body: Open enrollment is the one time of year everyone is asked to choose between HMOs, PPOs, deductibles and premiums, usually with a stack of paperwork and a headache.
Pick a Plan is a new video on Medics Musings about making sense of healthcare coverage. It runs under two minutes and it's on the homepage now.
imageAlt: Pick a Plan: a worried woman at a desk buried in insurance paperwork
